_comment: 2-row statement with a running balance. The balance chain audit in pdf.ts requires >= 3 rows with balances, so this statement gets NO sign audit at all. If column geometry assigns the wrong sign (e.g. due to a short amount overlapping a neighbouring column), nothing catches it. Row 1 is a debit (purchase), Row 2 is a credit (salary). Balance: 5000 → 4500 → 17500. The generic parser should assign the right signs from column geometry, but with no audit, a geometry error is silently trusted.
